params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the number of records to retrieve. Minimum value is `1`. Maximum value is `200`. If omitted, the system uses the default value of `50`.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies the starting record to retrieve. Minimum value is `0`. If omitted, the system uses the default value of `0`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Specifies the field and order to sort results by. Valid format: `scan_creation_date:desc` or `scan_creation_date:asc`. If omitted, the system uses the default value of `scan_creation_date:desc`.

Returns a list of remediation scans where you have at least CAN VIEW [16] scan permissions. 

**Note:** Keep in mind potential [rate limits](doc:rate-limiting) when using this endpoint. To check the status of your scans, use the [Get latest scan status](ref:scans-get-latest-status) endpoint. **Note:** Tenable Vulnerability Management limits the number of scans you can create to 10,000 scans. Tenable recommends you re-use scheduled scans instead of creating new scans.
